summary: Iteration 22: Tested WebAuthn/Passkey authentication feature (optional biometric login). All 32 backend tests PASS. Full frontend E2E verified: passkey button visible, password login works, passkey registration prompt shows after login (for users with no passkeys), skip button works, error handling correct.

issues: When passkey login fails in unsupported env, the raw browser error 'Resident credentials or empty allowCredentials lists are not supported at this time.' is shown. Could be more user-friendly, e.g. 'Passkey not available on this device'. Minor UX note only.

critical_code_review_comments: _user_from_doc correctly strips passkeys array and exposes only has_passkeys boolean flag
auth-options endpoint does not require auth (correct — needed for initial WebAuthn ceremony)
register-options endpoint correctly requires auth via get_current_user
webauthn_challenges collection has TTL index (expireAfterSeconds=600) for auto-cleanup
cookie secure=False is correct for this HTTP preview environment
auth-verify error messages appropriately distinguish missing credential vs expired session vs unknown passkey
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Admin user has no passkeys registered (has_passkeys=false).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22: WebAuthn/Passkey feature fully tested. Key points: (1) All 5 passkey endpoints working correctly (auth-options, register-options, register-verify, auth-verify, list). (2) auth-options does NOT require auth and sets wauthn_session cookie with TTL=300s. (3) Login + /me responses include has_passkeys boolean, no raw passkeys array. (4) Frontend: passkey button visible at top, password form below divider. After admin login passkey registration prompt shows (admin has no passkeys). Skip navigates to app. (5) WebAuthn biometric ceremony cannot be automated - requires real device. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_passkey_webauthn.py (32 tests). The app image used (rural shop) is relevant to the NBFC-MFI context.
